SEARCH
Module org.maxicp
Package org.maxicp.modeling

Class Factory

java.lang.Object
org.maxicp.modeling.Factory
public final class Factory extends Object
Modeling factory providing static helper methods to create model dispatchers, objectives, symbolic integer/boolean/cumulative expressions, and high-level modeling constraints.
